text_block_list.name: Wolf-Cut Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
—So yeah, the cake is already in the fridge.
All that's left is to hurry up and decorate the venue...

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Aight, I'll help out too.
What else is there~...

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Wait, it's you...!

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Don't scare me like that~.
Ah geez... we're setting up a surprise for Pokke.

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Well... yeah, y'know?
She's been working crazy hard lately.
So it's like a "good job" or "congrats~" kinda thing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, she had been performing brilliantly lately.
Her presence was truly that of a "leading star of the new era"...!
I had been deeply moved by her as well.
choice_data_list: I want to show her my appreciation too!
I want to show her my appreciation too!

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
For real? Guess I'll make you our errand runner~.
Go sneak off and get it, it's a secret from Pokk—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Yo, what're you guys up to~?

text_block_list.name: Wolf-Cut Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Ack! Pokke-san?!
Uhhhhh, well, nothing really...?
It's totally nothing~~! Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ah...? What's with you guys.
Oi, what were you talking about?

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Nooo, it's that thing, y'know!
Uhh, what was it again, Trainer-san~?
choice_data_list: Eh?! Uh, a new training theory—!

text_block_list.name: Wolf-Cut Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
All right, now's our chance...!
We'll go ahead with prep, we'll leave the rest to you!

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: —So like... wanna go hang out for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Huuuuh~? No, what is going on?
Where'd those guys go?
choice_data_list: More importantly, let's grab some good food...!

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Here, Pokke, you can have a bite, 'kay?
Say "aah".

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, really?
Sweet~~♪

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Wait, no!
If you know something, spill it—!
choice_data_list: I-I wonder? Oh look, an arcade!

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Isn't that cute?
Want anything? I'll win it for ya!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Don't want it...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ain't doing it............
Hmph...

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh~... My bad...
But like... it's not what you think...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
............I get it, alright.
I know it ain't anything bad.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Still, it pisses me off when you hide stuff!
So...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Take me somewhere way more fun!
Or else I'm heading back to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...! *snicker*... Hahahaha.
What are you, a kid?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Shut up, you're a kid too!
Ahhh damn it, I want something fizzy to drink.

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Alright alright, Trainer-san will go buy it for ya.
Hehe... no seriously, for real though...

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Even though she acts like this, in a race she's "like that".
She's pretty amazing, huh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few hours later, the three of us headed to the party venue.
A whole crowd of Jungle Pocket's underlings and friends
had gathered there...!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Yaaay! Surpriiiise!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: You guys...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
What the heck, so that's what this was?!
Ahahahaha! Thanks a lot!

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Sheesh, keeping it under wraps was such a pain.
Well then, to "Today's Main Star☆", once again...

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Good job. And congrats.
No joke... you really are the "Strongest"!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...Heheheh!
Damn straight!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Jungle Pocket's mood did a complete turnaround as she rejoiced.
In her innocent eyes,
a fathomless, intense light burned brightly.
